not_extracted.reason: This joint test includes the excluded ChatGPT-only arm and is not the contrast between the randomized participant arms. That pairwise contrast is extracted with its output-based uncertainty flagged. PDF p. 3 (printed p. 1908), Results, Experiment 2B.

open_items: Per-arm participant counts and the total number randomized are not printed for any experiment. Completion counts and planned sample sizes are not substituted for randomized counts; degrees of freedom are not used to derive counts.
S2: the study-wide analyzed count includes all conditions; the people in each pairwise contrast cannot be counted from the printed text, so estimate n_total is null.

S3: the uncertainty uses a model that includes unedited ChatGPT-only outputs. A participant-only standard error and the definition of the reported standardized effect cannot be confirmed. The arm counts are missing. No total model-output count is entered by addition.
The standardizer for Cohen’s d is not defined in the supplied PDF. Missing raw differences, SEs and SDs are not reconstructed from the printed tests or intervals.

S1: originality and appropriateness have no printed arm means or SDs. Fluency has no printed arm levels, no stated direction and a t/P combination flagged as inconsistent by screening. The top-ranked share has only a qualitative direction; its threshold, arm percentages and uncertainty are missing.
S2: expert creativity arm means and SDs are missing. S3: expert creativity arm SDs are missing. S4: the full expert creativity contrast is not printed.

S5 and S6: the lay-rating technology ANOVA terms are not accepted as distinct pooled effects because of the simple-effect ambiguity identified at screening. Full-sample lay contrasts and their arm levels remain unavailable.

Supplementary Notes A–K are separate from the supplied PDF. No companion supplement was found beside the source files. Requests via Python urllib to the named OSF project API and then the publisher article both failed because socket access was denied; supplement results and preregistered primary outcomes could not be checked.
The model release year is not stated. Study data-collection years are not substituted for the AI tool release year.

Preregistration is not stated for Experiments 1 and 3. For the other experiments the paper names registrations and preregistered collection procedures but does not explicitly identify preregistered primary outcomes.

Reporting Summary inconsistencies remain: the power analysis is attributed to Experiment 2A there but to Experiment 2B in Methods, and the summary supplies no exclusion count for Experiment 2B. These do not change the explicitly printed analyzed count.
The supplied PDF prints inconsistent SDs for the excluded ChatGPT-only arm and mislabels the Web-search/Low-constraint row in Table 1. Neither ambiguity is used to populate an eligible numeric field.
notes: Extracted on 2026-10-09. Read the complete markdown, including references, back matter and the Reporting Summary, after reviewing the Methods before the Results. Checked all cited pages with PyMuPDF and recovered Table 1 with find_tables(). Quotes retain the PDF wording and signs with whitespace normalized; printed precision is preserved in the quotes. All extracted outcomes are immediate with_ai outcomes; this paper reports no across_people or after_ai measure. The abstract counts five experiments; separate study records follow the six labels in the paper: 1, 2A, 2B, 3, 4 and 5. Reported confidence bounds are for Cohen’s d and are stored only under paper_effect; ci_level and ci_of identify them. No means are subtracted, arm counts inferred, SDs reconstructed or standardized effects recomputed. The top-ranked-share record is retained because the full-sample contrast is stated, although all its effect statistics are null. The shared-sample statement comes from the reconciled screening form and codebook; it is not a claim that this paper cites the later reanalysis. Preregistered primary status is not inferred from the paper’s emphasis on overall creativity. Study arms list randomized cells; the expert estimates for the factorial experiments use the pooled technology labels in the screening form and name the combined cells in their notes.
